title: Attack, defend and score
outcome: Players recognize chances to score, protect a goal and attack quickly after winning the ball.

fourCorners.technical: players strike the ball on goal after receiving or carrying it into space
fourCorners.physical: players sprint into space to arrive as the ball does
fourCorners.psychological: players recover quickly after losing the ball and stay ready to attack again

coach_cues: Can you see an open goal?
Can you get between the ball and goal?
What can you do when you win it?

activities.variation: Explore both goals, look up and shoot when the road opens.
Short 1v1 rounds with an immediate counterattack after a ball win.
activities.setup_note: Same two lanes and mini goals as goal-rush; narrow each lane slightly and hand out bibs to split into 1v1 pairs.

progression.note: First half. Coach-managed restarts; rotate the goalkeeper.
Second half, same setup. Switch ends; rotate anyone who hasn't played every role.
